fields.description: Default Sales Taxes and Charges Template applied to POS invoices when no template is chosen at check-in or set on the POS Profile.
fields.label: Default Tax Template

fields.description: Hourly scheduler re-submits invoices stuck in Not Submitted / Failed / Pending to EIRMS.
fields.label: Auto-Retry Failed/Backlogged Submissions

fields.description: Stop auto-retrying an invoice after this many failed attempts to avoid wedging the queue.
fields.label: Max Auto-Retries Per Invoice

fields.description: Send the buyer a PDF of the registered invoice after EIRMS confirmation (Art 4(1), 22(5)(b)). Also used for cancellation notices.
fields.label: Email Registered Receipt to Buyer

fields.description: Send SMS invoice notifications (registration + cancellation) to the buyer's phone via AfroMessage. Configure the provider in the SMS Notifications section below.
fields.label: SMS Notifications Enabled

fields.description: Allows any visitor to verify an invoice by IRN at /invoice_verify. Returns seller name, date, total and status only.
fields.label: Enable Public Invoice Verification

fields.description: Falls back to a live MoR /v1/verify lookup for IRNs not found in this system. Uses the seller's credentials; recommended only for dedicated installations.
fields.label: Query MoR When Not Found Locally

fields.description: When ticked, further EIRMS registrations are blocked (Directive Art 8). Export your data before purging; use eims.data_management.terminate_service via the terminal/Server Script.
fields.label: Service Terminated

fields.description: Set the minimum amount of transaction cost to apply withholding for an invoice to be prepared for goods. the default is 20,000
fields.label: Minimum Transaction Amount for Withholding Goods

fields.description: Set the minimum amount of transaction cost to apply withholding for an invoice to be prepared for services. the default is 10,000
fields.label: Minimum Transaction Amount for Withholding Services

fields.description: Message API send endpoint. Point this at the sandbox base URL to test without sending real SMS.
fields.label: Message Base URL

fields.description: Your Message bearer token (from the token parameter). Stored encrypted at rest.
fields.label: Message Token

fields.description: The Message 'from' identifier (fromId) issued with your account.
fields.label: Message From (Sender ID)

fields.description: Optional short sender name shown to the recipient. Leave empty to use the From sender ID.
fields.label: Sender Name (Optional)

fields.description: Optional callback/webhook URL AfroMessage calls with delivery status. Leave empty if unused.
fields.label: Delivery Callback (Optional)
